verdict.rationale: First-party marketing says users can 'easily forward physical items wherever you need them' and have checks forwarded directly to a bank, so self-service forwarding exists in some form. Nothing in the pack shows how forwarding is triggered or configured. Missing for 10: rule-based or automatic forwarding, one-click forwarding UI, saved recipient addresses, carrier choice, shipping cost shown before confirming, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
